Task frame: You are assigning a single primitive in the Imscribing Grammar (a 12-coordinate universal type system). You will receive the input description and one primitive to assign. Input: gravity in the SIXTEEN_3 trilattice

Assigning primitive ⊣ (topology).
Question: What is the connectivity pattern of influence?

Options:
  1. 𐑡  — Generic network — connected graph, hub-spoke, mixed connectivity
  2. 𐑰  — Containment / branched tree — partners enter a container or nested hierarchy
  3. 𐑥  — Cyclic closure — cyclic interface, figure-8, double-well
  4. 𐑶  — Fully enclosed — partner cannot exit without distorting the container
  5. 𐑸  — Scale-collapse — connectivity in which the boundary carries the full bulk content losslessly (requires 𐑦 dimensionality)

Primitives assigned so far: {}

Reply with ONLY the option number (1–5), followed by one sentence of reasoning.
Example: "2 — The system organizes spatially across an extended lattice."
Do NOT write anything else before the number.
1 — Gravity manifests as a long-range, all-to-all force mediated by a connected graph where massive bodies act as hubs with distance-weighted spokes.
